title: USDA AD-1052
description: Federal fiscal-year drug-free-workplace certification for a State (all State agencies) or a single State agency. Fiscal year, scope, agency/project and workplaces are entered separately from cover-owned representative and submission context.
notes: Pinned original FID696/version2.0 PDF, XLS and three-file XSD import closure are authoritative for this definition. The source OMB expiration September30,2025 and revision12/22 are preserved; no newer official edition is inferred.

CertificationType requires exactly State (All State Agencies) or Single State Agency. AgencyName is entered information despite the ORGANIZATION NAME label; it is independent from AD1049 cover-owned OrganizationName and no scope is inferred from agency text.

Federal Fiscal Year is a string with exactly four decimal digits, preserving leading zeros and excluding XSD1.0 year0000. This explicitly implements DAT row7 four-character YEAR admission alongside XSD xs:gYear; signed/extended/timezone gYear lexemes remain raw-source-valid controls but outside this declared DAT subset. No numeric/date coercion, current-year default or1900..2100 range is introduced.

AD1052 DAT O40 limits postal text to10 characters while GlobalLibrary ZipPostalCodeDataType permits30. The definition preserves the narrower DAT use without changing shared bank AddressParts or raw XSD target limits.

The shared USDA workplace-address composition uses existing bank parts/enums and per-entry activity proven by the AD1049 pilot. This use specializes only postal maximum10; inherited conditional state/postal requiredness and inactive State/Province retention need compiled transfer proof.
Workplaces are optional0..10. The on-file checkbox is an independent exact Y: Yes/N: No answer; absence does not default No or certify compliance.

Representative name/title are forward-populated from the application cover. Signature/date are completed by Grants.gov upon submission. Full-contract samples contain explicitly illustrative producer context; an applicant-only draft remains incomplete against transmitted source-required context.

Full State-specific privacy/routing/suspension notice, commitments, PRA/civil-rights statement and page-three instructions are retained in nonempty layout descriptions. Source wording differences from AD1049 are preserved.

The source-shaped XSD target has no active Mapping.from. The original XSD, including raw xs:gYear and postal30 semantics, remains authoritative; XML strategy, authentic context/signing/submission and production registration are integration dependencies.

risks: Inheritance/source specialization must be compiled and exercised through the existing native preview. AD1049 browser qualification establishes the matched base, not automatic AD1052 acceptance.
Full raw xs:gYear lexical admission differs from the DAT four-character capture restriction; the difference is explicit and no source waiver or calendar-year coercion is inferred.

DAT requires MM-DD-YYYY display; this form's native date presentation is not yet qualified. JSON retains an ISO date. Exact complaint-page/mailto destinations are retained as text while clickable behavior remains a shared presentation integration gap.
Readonly presentation and illustrative context are not authentic population, signing, legal certification or human acceptance.
